_comment: WIMP-nucleon SI rate generation config: Si target, 1-10 GeV mass range. Generates dR/dE_ee CSVs (quenched to electron-equivalent energy) via ccdarkphys.wimp_nucleon. Run: python3 utils/wimp_nucleon_generate_grid.py configs/wimp_nucleon_generate_si_heavy.json. Remove the 'quenching' block to get Phase 1's raw dR/dE_R output instead.

halo._comment: Baxter et al. 2021 (EPJC 81, 907) Table 1 -- matches ccdarkphys.migdal's darkelf calls. Omit any key to fall back to these same defaults.

quenching._comment: chavarria_table = measured Si nuclear recoil ionization efficiency, Chavarria et al. 2016 (Phys. Rev. D 94, 082007), Table I, with linear-to-zero below 0.68 keV_nr (crossing at 0.3 keV_nr per PhysRevD.94.082006) and Lindhard fallback above 2.28 keV_nr (no measurement there). See python/ccdarkphys/wimp_nucleon/quenching.py. Alternative: 'lindhard'.
